title: 보이는 대로, 생각한 대로: -는 듯 vs -는 줄 알았어요
objective: By the end, you can use -는 듯 to describe how something looks or seems, and -는 줄 알았다/몰랐다 to say what you thought or didn't expect. You can also choose the right form (-는, -(으)ㄴ or -(으)ㄹ) for each one.
summary: Learn how -는 듯 describes how something seems and -는 줄 알았다/몰랐다 says what you thought or didn't know.

task.title: Choose and complete
task.line: Pick 듯 or 줄, then put the word in the right form: -는, -(으)ㄴ, -(으)ㄹ or 인.

forms.when: Something seems true right now, based on what you see. 있다/없다 words take -는.
forms.example: 민수 씨가 피곤한 듯 계속 하품을 해요.
forms.exampleMeaning: Minsu keeps yawning, as if he's tired.

forms.when: Something seems to have already happened.
forms.means: as if ~ already / it seems ~ happened
forms.example: 그 사람은 저를 못 본 듯 그냥 지나갔어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: He just walked past, as if he hadn't seen me.

forms.when: You guess about something that hasn't happened yet. -듯해요 is a soft, polite way to guess.
forms.exampleMeaning: The meeting looks like it'll run long. Please go ahead and eat.

forms.form: V-는 줄 / A-(으)ㄴ 줄 / N인 줄 + 알았다
forms.when: You believed something, and often you later found out it wasn't true.
forms.example: 지수 씨가 회사에 다니는 줄 알았어요. 그런데 대학원생이었어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: I thought Jisu worked at a company, but she was a grad student.

forms.when: You didn't know or expect something. Use -(으)ㄹ 줄 for something you didn't see coming. This is different from -(으)ㄹ 줄 알다, which means 'know how to'.
forms.exampleMeaning: I didn't expect it to be this cold today.

watchOut: 맛있은 듯 (X) → 맛있는 듯 (O): words ending in 있다/없다 take -는, just like verbs.
끝나는 줄 몰랐어요 vs 끝난 줄 몰랐어요: both are natural. 끝나는 줄 means you didn't know it was ending right now; 끝난 줄 means you didn't know it had already ended.
의사는 줄 알았어요 (X) → 의사인 줄 알았어요 (O): after a noun, use 인 줄 or 인 듯.
아픈 줄 얼굴이 하얘요 (X) → 아픈 듯 얼굴이 하얘요 (O): 듯 says how something looks. 줄 goes with 알다/모르다.
exercises: Choose the right expression: ① 동생이 화가 (난 듯 / 난 줄) 문을 세게 닫았어요. ② 저는 동생이 아직 (자는 듯 / 자는 줄) 알았어요. ③ 하늘이 흐려서 곧 눈이 (올 듯해요 / 올 줄 해요).
Change the word in brackets using -는 듯 or -(으)ㄴ 듯: 주말인데 거리에 사람이 (없다) ____ 조용해요.
Change the word in brackets using -(으)ㄴ 줄. The action already happened: 열쇠를 집에 (두다) ____ 알았는데 가방 안에 있었어요.
Change the word in brackets using -(으)ㄹ 줄. You did not expect this: 시험이 이렇게 (어렵다) ____ 몰랐어요.
Change the noun in brackets so it goes with 줄: 저는 그분이 (선생님) ____ 알았어요. 그런데 학생 어머니였어요.
Join the two sentences into one using -는 줄 몰랐어요: 친구가 한국어를 아주 잘해요. 저는 그걸 몰랐어요. → 친구가 한국어를 ____ 몰랐어요.
answers: ① 난 듯 ② 자는 줄 ③ 올 듯해요
아주 잘하는 줄 (also possible: 잘하는 줄)
